# A3 results: oversight API

Milestone A3 of `docs/12-build-plan-phase-2.md` section 4, built 2026-11-21 on `stuart-parkinson_xero/feature-flow-a3`
from a design note, six builder tasks (contracts and OpenAPI first; then reasons and run context, attention and
history, server-sent events, and artifacts with plan revisions and templates in parallel; then reminders), an
independent review and two fix passes. `main` was merged in after A5 (PR #40). Every done-when item is built and
shown by a test seen to fail when the code it guards is broken. No live run was needed. No recorded replay history
changed; one was added (`reminder`).

## What was built

| Item | Change |
|---|---|
| L3 / G7 | Every request and response body is a record of a new project, `FeatureFlow.Api.Contracts`, used by the API and the CLI (LOG 388). JSON is snake_case, enums included; bodies are read inside the authentication guard, unknown properties refused (LOG 407, 409 to 411); store records are mapped to view records; one error shape. The OpenAPI 3.1 document is generated by ASP.NET Core from route metadata, with operation ids for a generated client and a bearer security scheme, served at `GET /openapi.json` and committed at `src/FeatureFlow.Api/openapi.json` (LOG 390). `WaitRecord.Reason` renamed `Prompt` (LOG 389) |
| F5 / G3 | A required reason on answers (except an agent's question), aborts, overrides and session abandonment, at most 4 KB, refused 400 by the API; engine-written reasons for chat buttons and reason-less session submissions (LOG 391, 392, 412, 432). The reason is on `AnswerRecord`, `ClosedWait` and the timeline; `min_count` counts people who answer the same way in different words together. The core keeps a run context (step summaries, answers with reasons, work-failure retry causes, the parent's context for a child), renders it at most 16 KB with each entry at most 4.5 KB, and passes it in the agent step's spec; the agent activity writes it into the prompt for `context: full` (LOG 405, 414, 415, 433). CLI `--reason` (LOG 413) |
| F9 / G5 | The agent activity indexes each session's prompt and transcript (`prompt:<n>`, `transcript:<n>`), failed attempts included; a parent run cannot consume them (LOG 393; LOG 325 amended). `GET /runs/{id}/artifacts` lists the run's index by kind; the artifact route also serves what a wait of the run names as consumed. A gate's wait records the artifacts its step consumed, with references, when it opens (LOG 394) |
| G1 | `GET /attention`: open waits of running runs the caller may answer now, oldest first, over a new `open_waits` store query (SQLite and Postgres, schema script 2), less waits the caller has already answered while a `min_count` rule waits for others (LOG 435) |
| G2 | `GET /me` (actor, channel, groups, organisation and team roles). `can_answer` per wait on `GET /runs/{id}`, from `CheckAnswer`, the one function the answer path also uses (LOG 418 to 420); `overrides_allowed` (LOG 417); read routes read libraries through a 60 s cache (LOG 395) |
| G4 | `GET /runs/{id}` holds closed waits with the answer that closed them, `min_count` and progress, every answer record and every override (LOG 396, 421) |
| G8 | `GET /events`: server-sent change notifications (`run_changed`, `wait_opened`, `wait_closed`, `reset`) for runs the caller views. The record store writes a `changes` table in `AppendAsync`'s transaction (Postgres under a transaction advisory lock, schema script 3, so sequence order is commit order); one `ChangeFeed` per API process polls it, with a ring of 1,024 for `Last-Event-ID`, bounded subscriber channels, a heartbeat and a bounded run cache (LOG 397 to 399, 422 to 424) |
| G10 | `GET /templates`: each library's entrypoints with the template's parameters, literal defaults as JSON text and expression defaults named, and the libraries that could not be read (LOG 400, 434) |
| G11 / F18, engine part | Each accepted plan revision is recorded as a `PlanSource` through the existing record activity and indexed as `plan_revision`, each once in a run's life (LOG 404, 430); `GET /runs/{id}/plan` serves the current revision as data (`PlanView`) and readable text (LOG 425 to 428; LOG 231 amended). `ff run plan`; `ff run override … --change name=@file` (LOG 406) |
| F21 / G14 | `notifications.reminder_interval` (no default, at least `1m`, fixed at run start; LOG 401, 431). The core arms `ArmReminder` when a wait opens and accepts a numbered `ReminderDue`, re-arming after a hand-over; the shell only sleeps; the notifier sends a `reminder` event once per number while the wait is open; Slack titles it "Reminder <n>" (LOG 402, 403, 429; LOG 232 amended) |
| Documents | `docs/02` sections 5 and 7; `docs/04` sections 3, 3.1, 3.4, 3.5, 4 and 7; `docs/05` sections 5 and 8; `docs/06` sections 3.10 and 3.12; `docs/07` section 3; `docs/08`; `docs/10`. No "planned (`docs/12` A3 …)" marker remains |

Suites at the head: build 0 warnings; default suite 24 projects (Api 149, Architecture 24, Replay 44); Integration

## Controls

Each named check was seen to fail with the code it guards broken, then pass restored: about 60 by the builders and
the fix passes, recorded in their reports, and five by the reviewer. Mine on the merged branch are listed in the
sub-orchestrator's report.

## Size

`src` +5,330 / −433 lines against `main` after A5 (62 files), most of it new routes, records, the change feed and the
run context; tests +2,899 / −438. The OpenAPI document is generated, not written.

## Deviations and judgement calls

- The design note's `from_library` marking of template parameters was dropped: the engine does not apply library
  `inputs` (`docs/03` section 6.2 says it should) (LOG 434).
- "Generated in the build" is met by a default-suite test that regenerates the document and compares it with the
  committed file, not by a build-time generator, which would run the host's entry point (LOG 390).
- The review's R2 (a session check's prompt colliding with a step's next execution) is not a defect: a check runs only
  an `artifact.validate` action (LOG 238), which indexes no prompt or transcript.
- Three product-owner questions were answered provisionally and flagged: chat answers carry an engine-written reason
  (LOG 391); templates are open to any authenticated caller (LOG 400); no default reminder interval (LOG 401).

## Follow-ups

1. Product owner: LOG 391, 400, 401 and 434 (apply library `inputs`, or remove them from `docs/03`).
2. `open_waits` returns at most 500 open waits per organisation before the caller's filter; page by scope in R4
   (`docs/06` section 3.12). Change rows are not pruned until R4.
3. A4: the events client is hand-written over `fetch` (a `reset` frame's data is `{}`, not a `ChangeEvent`).
4. An existing local SQLite database keeps its old full `waits_open` index (no migration in alpha, LOG 263).
5. `FindingsActionTests.A_review_pending_past_the_timeout_is_unavailable` (from before A3) is a real-time test that
   can fail under full-suite load.
